oneLiner: 相对性原理 + 光速不变原理：所有惯性系物理定律相同，真空中光速恒为 c。
oneLinerEn: Relativity + light-speed invariance: laws are same in all inertial frames; c is constant.
detail: 狭义相对论立在两条公设上。其一，相对性原理：所有惯性系里物理定律的形式完全相同，没有任何实验能在一辆匀速直行的封闭车厢里告诉你“车在动”——把「惯性系」与「匀速直线运动」摆在一起，这就是伽利略对力学说过的话，爱因斯坦把它推广到电磁学与光学。其二，光速不变原理：真空中的光对任何惯性系的观测者都以同一速率 c≈3×10⁸ 米每秒传播，与光源跑多快无关，数值与「光速」条一致。这两句话写于 1905 年。那一年爱因斯坦连发四篇论文——光电效应、布朗运动、六月的狭义相对论、九月补上的质能关系——史称奇迹年，作者当时的身份是伯尔尼专利局的三级技术员。它们之所以革命，是因为十九世纪末的物理看似只差修补：麦克斯韦方程组直接给出电磁波的速度是一个定值，可照速度叠加的常识，不同观测者应当测出不同数值。为弥合这个裂缝，人们假设宇宙充满一种叫“以太”的媒质，它同时充当绝对静止的标准；1887 年迈克尔逊与莫雷用干涉仪比较相互垂直的两臂光程，随地球公转换季转向，始终看不到预期的条纹移动——应当有的移动约 0.4 条，实测不到它的几十分之一，这桩最著名的失败在「迈克尔逊-莫雷实验」条有完整账目。爱因斯坦的取舍是干脆删掉以太：不需要媒质，也不需要绝对静止。承认两条公设，绝对时空就随之报废。洛伦兹与庞加莱其实早已写下联系两个惯性系坐标与时刻的变换式，x′=(x−vt)/√(1−v²/c²)、t′=(t−vx/c²)/√(1−v²/c²)；洛伦兹把它当作以太中的动力学效应，庞加莱也逼近了正确的数学结构，是爱因斯坦给出了物理意义：时间与空间的分划本身依赖参考系。低速时 v≪c，根号趋近一，变换退回伽利略的简单相加，新理论在这一点上必须通过对应原理的关卡，思路见「理想模型」与「极限法与微元思想」两条。三条推论由此展开：「时间膨胀」「长度收缩」与「同时的相对性」，而换不了的是时空间隔与因果次序。两点误解要挑明：一，相对论并非“什么都相对”，它恰恰把光速、把物理定律的形式写成对所有观测者都相同的不变量；二，“狭义”指只管没有引力、彼此匀速的惯性系，把引力收进来是十年后的「广义相对论与时空弯曲」条。至于光速为什么偏偏是极限、远星系又如何能退行超光而不违犯本条，见「同时的相对性」与「宇宙膨胀与红移」两条。
detailEn: Special relativity rests on two postulates. The first, the principle of relativity, says the laws of physics take the same form in every inertial frame, so no experiment inside a smoothly travelling sealed carriage can tell you that “the train is moving” — for mechanics Galileo had already said this of inertial frames and uniform straight-line motion; Einstein extended it to electromagnetism and optics. The second, the invariance of the speed of light, says that light in vacuum propagates at the same c ≈ 3×10⁸ m/s for every inertial observer, no matter how fast the source moves, the same value recorded in the entry on the speed of light. Both were published in 1905, the annus mirabilis in which Einstein produced four papers — on the photoelectric effect, on Brownian motion, on special relativity in June, and on mass–energy in September — while working as a third-class examiner at the Bern patent office. They were revolutionary because late-nineteenth-century physics seemed to need only repairs: Maxwell's equations hand back a fixed wave speed, yet everyday velocity addition says different observers should measure different ones. To close that gap physicists supposed space was filled with an “ether” that also served as absolute rest. In 1887 Michelson and Morley compared the light paths of two perpendicular arms of an interferometer as Earth changed its heading through the year and saw no fringe shift — about 0.4 fringes should have appeared, and the result was under a few tens of that; the entry on the Michelson–Morley experiment keeps the full accounts. Einstein simply deleted the ether: no medium, no absolute rest, and absolute space and time go with it. Lorentz and Poincaré had already written the transformations linking coordinates and times between frames, x′=(x−vt)/√(1−v²/c²) and t′=(t−vx/c²)/√(1−v²/c²); Lorentz read them as dynamical effects in the ether and Poincaré came close to the right group structure, but it was Einstein who gave them physical meaning — the partition of time and space itself depends on the frame. At low speeds v≪c the square root tends to one and the transformation collapses into Galileo's simple addition, the correspondence test any new theory must pass, in the spirit of the entries on idealised models and on limiting and element arguments. Three consequences unfold from the postulates: time dilation, length contraction and the relativity of simultaneity, while the spacetime interval and the order of causally linked events stay invariant. Two misconceptions to correct: relativity is not the claim that “everything is relative” — it is precisely a theory of invariants, c among them; and “special” means it governs only gravity-free frames in mutual uniform motion, which ten years later the general theory superseded. Why light speed is a limit, and how distant galaxies can recede faster than it without breaking the postulates, is treated in the entries on simultaneity and on cosmic expansion and redshift.

detail: 运动的钟走得慢：Δt=Δt₀/√(1−v²/c²)，式中 Δt₀ 是随钟一同运动的观测者测得的两次滴答间隔，称为原时或固有时，Δt 是相对该钟以速率 v 运动的观测者测得的更长间隔，c 为光速，因子 γ=1/√(1−v²/c²) 在 0.6c 时为 1.25、0.8c 时约 1.67，要慢到十倍得跑到 0.995c。推导只要一支光钟和勾股定理：相距 1 米的两面镜子之间光来回一次算一个滴答，车上的人看光走直线，站台上的人看它走斜边；路程变长而光速不变（「狭义相对论基本原理」条的第二条），钟就必然变慢。变的不是机械，是时间本身——心跳、化学反应、衰变、衰老都按同一比例放慢，车里的人永远感觉不到自己慢。这份相互性看着像矛盾：两边都看见对方的钟慢，化解要靠「同时的相对性」条，因为比较两处的时刻本身需要约定。证据最漂亮的是 μ 子：静止的 μ 子平均只活 2.2 微秒，即便以光速也只能走约 660 米，可宇宙线与高空大气相撞产生的 μ 子大量抵达海平面；按 0.995c 计 γ=10，地面看到它的寿命延长到约 22 微秒、可飞约 6.6 千米，而 μ 子自己的说法是 15 千米厚的大气沿运动方向被压到 1.5 千米——同一件事的两种记账，另一面见「长度收缩」条。钟也真被搬上过天：1971 年哈菲勒与基廷带着铯原子钟分别向东、向西绕地球飞行，落地后与海军天文台的基准钟比出纳秒级的差，与理论相符，数字口径见「原子钟与秒的定义」条；导航卫星每天要为速度项扣掉约 7 微秒，同一条也记在那边。加速器里不稳定粒子能飞过的距离成倍拉长，是本条在工程上的日常（见「粒子加速器」条）。至于“双生子佯谬”：以 0.8c 出行的旅行者过 10 年，地球上过去 16.7 年，回来的人确实更年轻；破谬的关键是旅行者中途必须调头、并不一直待在同一个惯性系里，谁经历加速谁的原时更短。日常尺度上完全可以忽略——时速 300 千米的高铁跑满一天，钟只差约 3 纳秒。两处易错：一是同一对事件在随动系里的原时最短，别说成“钟不准”；二是别把眼睛看到的光行时差与测量结果混为一谈，那是另一笔账。
detailEn: A moving clock runs slow: Δt=Δt₀/√(1−v²/c²), where Δt₀ is the interval between two ticks measured by an observer riding with the clock — the proper time — and Δt is the longer interval measured by an observer relative to whom the clock moves at speed v, with c the speed of light. The factor γ=1/√(1−v²/c²) is 1.25 at 0.6c, about 1.67 at 0.8c, and reaches ten only at 0.995c. One light clock and Pythagoras give the derivation: a tick is a round trip of light between two mirrors a metre apart; a passenger sees a straight path, a platform observer sees a diagonal one, and since the route lengthens while the speed of light cannot change, the tick must take longer. Nothing mechanical is wrong — time itself is involved, so heartbeats, chemistry, decay and ageing all slow in the same proportion, and the traveller never feels late. The reciprocity looks like a contradiction, since each side sees the other's clock lagging; the way out is the relativity of simultaneity, because comparing times at two places requires a convention. The neatest evidence is the muon: at rest it lives about 2.2 microseconds, some 660 metres of light, yet muons created by cosmic rays high in the atmosphere reach sea level in numbers. At 0.995c, γ=10, so the ground sees its lifetime stretched to about 22 microseconds and roughly 6.6 kilometres of flight, while the muon's own version is that the 15 kilometre atmosphere is flattened to 1.5 kilometres — two bookkeeping styles for one fact, the other side being length contraction. Clocks have physically flown: in 1971 Hafele and Keating carried caesium clocks east and west around the world and found nanosecond-scale offsets against the US Naval Observatory reference, matching theory, with figures kept in the entry on atomic clocks and the definition of the second; navigation satellites deduct about 7 microseconds a day for the velocity term. Unstable particles in accelerators travel many times farther than their rest lifetimes allow, which is this effect as daily engineering. As for the twin paradox, a traveller at 0.8c who ages ten years returns to an Earth that has aged 16.7: the traveller is genuinely younger, and the paradox breaks because the turnaround means the traveller was never in one inertial frame throughout — whoever accelerates accumulates less proper time. At human scales the effect is negligible: a train at 300 km/h lagging about 3 nanoseconds over a whole day. Two slips to avoid: proper time is the shortest interval between the two events, not an inaccurate clock; and what an eye receives after light-travel delay is not the measurement itself.

oneLiner: 运动方向上的长度变短：L=L₀√(1−v²/c²)。
detail: 沿运动方向的长度变短：L=L₀√(1−v²/c²)，式中 L₀ 是物体相对自身静止时的原长，L 是相对它以速率 v 运动的观测者测得的长度，垂直于运动的尺寸不受影响，c 为光速。它与「时间膨胀」共用同一个因子 γ，只是位置相反——收缩是除以 γ。这个念头最初并非相对论的产物：1887 年迈克尔逊与莫雷找不到“以太风”之后，菲茨杰拉德在 1892 年、洛伦兹在 1895 年各自提出，物体沿运动方向会真的缩短那么一点，恰好抹平干涉仪两臂的程差，于是实验永远测不出什么。爱因斯坦的改动是把它从材料的机械变形升级为时空的分划方式：不是原子被压扁，而是“测量一个运动物体的长度”这件事本身就要求在同一时刻记下头尾两个坐标，而同时性按参考系重新划分（「同时的相对性」条），长度因此必然带上 γ。数值要算清：γ=2 需要约 0.87c，一根 6 米的杆此时量得 3 米；高铁的收缩只有十亿分之一的百亿分之几量级，日常测不到。著名的“撑杆过车库”佯谬由此而生：以 0.87c 冲来的 6 米杆，在车库方看来只剩 3 米，前后两扇门可以同时关上；杆上的人则说 3 米长的车库缩成 1.5 米，两扇门绝不同时关——两种说法都对，分歧只在“同时”，而且没有哪扇门会夹到杆，因为杆减速时的应力传递也不可能快过光速（因果上限见「狭义相对论基本原理」条）。真实世界里它已被反复检验：相对论重离子对撞时，金核沿束流方向被压成一片“薄饼”，核子密度陡然升高，正是这类环境让实验室得以复现极早期宇宙的高温（口径见「粒子物理与标准模型」条）；宇宙线 μ 子能抵达地面，用收缩来讲与用钟慢来讲同样简洁。三点易错：一、收缩只发生在运动方向，杆的粗细不变；二、它是测量的结果而非“眼睛看到的形状”——把光行时差算进去后，高速球体看起来是被旋转而不是被压扁，这叫特雷尔效应；三、原长最长，物体在自己的静止系里一切如常，别把收缩当成材料受损。至于为什么垂直方向不参与、以及它与钟慢如何出自同一条变换式（即洛伦兹变换，见「狭义相对论基本原理」条），回到那两条公设即可看清：变化的是时空坐标的分划，而不是物体受到的挤压。
detailEn: Lengths along the direction of motion shorten: L=L₀√(1−v²/c²), where L₀ is the rest length measured in the object's own frame, L the length found by an observer moving at speed v relative to it, c the speed of light, and dimensions perpendicular to the motion untouched. The same γ that dilates time appears inverted here — contraction is a division by γ. The idea began outside relativity: after Michelson and Morley failed to find an “ether wind” in 1887, Fitzgerald in 1892 and Lorentz in 1895 proposed that bodies really do shrink along the direction of travel by exactly enough to cancel the interferometer's path difference, so the experiment could never register anything. Einstein's revision was to promote this from mechanical strain to the way spacetime is partitioned: measuring the length of a moving body means recording the positions of its ends at the same time, and simultaneity is re-parted frame by frame, so the length must carry γ. The numbers: γ=2 needs about 0.87c, at which a 6 m pole measures 3 m, whereas a train contracts by a fraction far beyond everyday reach. The pole-in-the-barn paradox follows: driven at 0.87c, a 6 m pole fits a 3 m barn and both doors can shut together, while the pole's own account says a 3 m barn shrinks to 1.5 m and the doors cannot shut at once — both are right, the whole disagreement living in “at once”, and no door harms the pole because stopping stresses cannot travel faster than light either. Nature confirms it: in relativistic heavy-ion collisions gold nuclei are flattened into pancakes along the beam, raising nucleon density in the matter that recreates the early universe's heat, and the muons of cosmic rays reach the ground just as easily described by contraction as by slow clocks. Three slips: contraction runs only along the motion, so the pole keeps its thickness; it is a result of measurement, not of appearance — allowing for light-travel delay, a fast sphere looks rotated rather than squashed, the Terrell effect; and the rest length is the longest, the body suffering nothing in its own frame. Why the transverse size is exempt, and how this and slow clocks issue from one Lorentz transformation, is clearest straight from the two postulates: what changes is the partition of spacetime coordinates, not pressure on the material.

detail: E=mc² 说的是质量与能量本是一事：式中 E 为能量，m 为质量，c 为真空光速，换算系数 c²≈9×10¹⁶ 焦每千克，意味着一份静止质量本身就存着海量能量。物体不动时也有“静能”mc²，运动时总能量为 γmc²，动能只是多出的零头。核物理里最顺手的换算是 1 个原子质量单位对应 931.5 兆电子伏，于是核子结合得越紧、总质量剩得越少，「核力与结合能」条里的质量亏损就是这本账；电子的静能只有 0.511 兆电子伏，一对正负电子湮灭至少给出 1.022 兆电子伏的光子，反过来造出质量也要花这么多（见「波粒二象性」条）。数量级一算就懂：1 千克质量全部放出是 9×10¹⁶ 焦，约合 2150 万吨 TNT，是广岛那颗约 1.5 万吨当量的千余倍；倒过来更震撼——广岛那次爆炸真正消失的质量只有约 0.7 克。太阳每秒把约 426 万吨质量换成辐射，光度 3.8×10²⁶ 瓦，口径见「恒星的一生」与「核聚变」两条；一次铀核裂变约放 200 兆电子伏，四个质子合成一个氦核放 26.7 兆电子伏，见「核裂变与链式反应」与「核聚变」。化学燃烧同样服从这条定律，只是小到看不见：1 千克汽油放出约 4.6×10⁷ 焦，质量只减约 5×10⁻⁷ 克，占比约 5×10⁻¹⁰；1 千克水升温 80 摄氏度，内能增量对应质量增加约 3.7×10⁻¹² 千克（热量口径见「内能」条）——这正是天平在化学反应里够用、在核反应里不够用的原因。三点必须纠正：一、不是“物质消灭了、转化为能量”，质量本来就是能量的量度，能量带走时质量同行；封闭系统的总能量与总质量各自守恒，但各部分静止质量之和（静质量）可以不守恒，光子对产生与湮灭就是账面重排；二、E=mc² 不是原子弹的设计图，链式反应能否自持取决于中子增殖与临界质量，质能式只负责结算（详见「核能的利用」条）；三、把 m 写成“随速度增大的质量”是老写法，今天更主张用不变质量配上「质速关系」条的动量表达，免得与惯性质量、引力质量两重身份的讨论纠缠，后者见「等效原理」条。日常经验里这条式子并不遥远：称一台锅炉、烧一壶水、给电池充电，被充进去的能量都带着极小的质量入场，只是小到仪器看不见——它真正显形，是在核与星的尺度上。
detailEn: E=mc² states that mass and energy are one thing: E is energy, m is mass, and the conversion factor c², about 9×10¹⁶ joules per kilogram, says a body's rest mass already stores an immense account of energy. A stationary object still holds this rest energy, a moving one totals γmc², so kinetic energy is only the surplus. The handy unit in nuclear physics is 1 unified atomic mass unit = 931.5 MeV, which is how the entry on nuclear force and binding energy turns a mass defect into energy; an electron's rest energy is a mere 0.511 MeV, so annihilating a positron with it yields at least 1.022 MeV of photons and creating such a pair costs the same. The magnitudes: converting 1 kg outright releases 9×10¹⁶ J, some 21.5 million tonnes of TNT, over a thousand times the roughly 15 kilotonnes of Hiroshima — and read the other way, that explosion destroyed only about 0.7 g of mass. The Sun trades about 4.26 million tonnes of mass for radiation every second, a luminosity of 3.8×10²⁶ W, as the entries on stellar evolution and on nuclear fusion record; one fission of uranium yields about 200 MeV and four protons fused into helium 26.7 MeV. Chemistry obeys the same law at absurdly small scale: burning 1 kg of petrol frees about 4.6×10⁷ J and about 5×10⁻⁷ g of mass, a fraction near 5×10⁻¹⁰, and heating 1 kg of water by 80 °C adds roughly 3.7×10⁻¹² kg, which is why a balance suffices in the laboratory but not in the reactor. Three corrections. First, matter is not “destroyed and turned into energy”: mass is a measure of energy, so departing energy departs with its mass; total energy and total mass of a closed system are each conserved, yet the sum of the parts' rest masses need not be, as pair creation and annihilation show. Second, the formula is not a blueprint for a bomb — whether a chain reaction sustains itself depends on neutron multiplication and critical mass, while E=mc² merely settles the bill, as the entry on the use of nuclear energy details. Third, writing m as a “mass that grows with speed” is the old style; today one keeps the invariant mass and speaks of momentum instead, the relation set out in the entry on the mass-speed relation, avoiding tangles with the inertial and gravitational roles discussed under the equivalence principle. Nothing here is far from daily life: charging a battery or boiling water does carry energy's tiny mass aboard, only too little for instruments — it declares itself at the scale of nuclei and stars.

term: 广义相对论与时空弯曲
oneLiner: 引力被诠释为时空的弯曲，物质告诉时空如何弯曲。
oneLinerEn: Gravity is spacetime curvature caused by mass-energy.
detail: 广义相对论把引力解释成时空的弯曲。1915 年 11 月爱因斯坦交出场方程：左边描述时空的曲率，由黎曼 1854 年关于几何基础的讲演所开创的弯曲空间语言、里奇与列维-齐维塔的合同演算、以及与格罗斯曼数年苦算提供；右边是物质与能量的分布，比例系数含 8πG/c⁴，式中 G 为「引力常数」、c 为光速。惠勒的口诀最见骨：“物质告诉时空如何弯曲，时空告诉物质如何运动。”起点是一个念头——1907 年他说，自由下落的人感觉不到自己的重量；这条「等效原理」意味着引力可以靠选择参考系在局部消去，那么剩下需要解释的就是不同落点之间的相对加速，即潮汐，即曲率。三条经典检验全胜。其一，水星近日点每世纪比牛顿的账本多出 43 角秒，自 1859 年勒维耶指出后悬了半个多世纪（同一轨道账目的牛顿面见「万有引力定律」条），场方程给出的正是这 43 角秒，爱因斯坦据说是算完就躺下不干了。其二，掠过日面的星光偏折 1.75 角秒，恰是“光作为微粒被引力拉扯”这一早先算法值 0.875 角秒的两倍；1919 年 5 月 29 日日食，爱丁顿带队分赴普林西比岛与索布拉尔测得的结果与前者相符，爱因斯坦一夜成名，其后的复测、射电干涉与依巴谷卫星把偏差压到百分之一以内。其三，掠过太阳的雷达回波会被额外延迟几十微秒，即夏皮罗延迟，卡西尼号在 2003 年把理论与观测的差缩到十万分之几。清单此后越来越长：引力红移（1960 年庞德与雷布卡在 22.5 米高的塔里量得，见「引力使时间变慢」条）、脉冲双星轨道按引力波带走能量的速率收缩（见「引力波」条）、大质量天体把背景星光弯成弧与环的引力透镜——1936 年爱因斯坦算出、1979 年找到第一对双像类星体，如今用它称量「暗物质」，成环成像的一例见「黑洞」条——以及 2015 年 9 月 14 日 LIGO 直接收到的双黑洞并合 GW150914，两个约 36 与 29 倍太阳质量的黑洞合成 62 倍，约 3 倍太阳质量在 0.1 秒内按「质能方程」条换成时空的抖动。它也改了宇宙学：1917 年他为让宇宙静止而塞进宇宙学常数，膨胀被发现后他视之为最大失策，1998 年这个常数以暗能量的形式归来，约占宇宙总能量六成八（口径见「宇宙膨胀与红移」条）；旋转的质量还拖着时空同转，即参考系拖曳，引力探针 B 号测得每年约 39 毫角秒。两条边界要说清：低速弱场下它自动退回「万有引力定律」，这是新理论必须通过的对应原理；而它与量子理论至今没有统一，黑洞中心的奇点与普朗克尺度上的时空仍是悬案。
detailEn: General relativity reads gravity as the curvature of spacetime. In November 1915 Einstein produced the field equations: the left side describes curvature, in the language of curved space opened by Riemann's 1854 lecture on the foundations of geometry, worked out with Ricci and Levi-Civita's absolute calculus and years of labour with Grossmann; the right side is the distribution of matter and energy, coupled through 8πG/c⁴ with G the gravitational constant and c the speed of light. Wheeler's couplet is the sharpest summary: matter tells spacetime how to curve, spacetime tells matter how to move. The seed was 1907's thought that a falling person feels no weight — the equivalence principle, which lets gravity be removed locally by choosing a frame, so all that remains to explain is the relative acceleration of neighbouring falls, namely tides, namely curvature. The three classic tests all passed. Mercury's perihelion gains 43 arcseconds a century more than Newton's bookkeeping allows, an anomaly known since Le Verrier in 1859 (the Newtonian side of that account in the entry on universal gravitation), and the equations hand back exactly 43. Starlight grazing the Sun bends by 1.75 arcseconds, twice the 0.875 given by treating light as corpuscles pulled by gravity; expeditions led by Eddington to Príncipe and Sobral measured the 19 May 1919 eclipse, matched the larger figure and made Einstein famous overnight, with later re-observations, radio interferometry and Hipparcos tightening the deviation inside one per cent. Radar echoes skimming the Sun arrive tens of microseconds late — the Shapiro delay — and Cassini in 2003 squeezed the difference to a few parts in a hundred thousand. The list has only grown: the gravitational redshift measured by Pound and Rebka up a 22.5 m tower; the orbital decay of the 1974 binary pulsar at precisely the rate gravitational waves carry energy away; gravitational lensing, arcs and rings, computed by Einstein in 1936, seen as the first double quasar in 1979 and now used to weigh dark matter; and LIGO's direct detection on 14 September 2015 of two black holes of 36 and 29 solar masses merging into 62, some 3 solar masses converted in 0.1 seconds into a ripple of spacetime. Cosmology changed with it: the cosmological constant inserted in 1917 to hold the universe still, later called his greatest blunder, returned in 1998 as dark energy accounting for roughly sixty-eight per cent of the cosmic budget; and rotating mass drags spacetime with it, frame dragging, measured by Gravity Probe B at about 39 milliarcseconds a year. Two frontiers to state plainly: in slow, weak fields the theory collapses back into Newton's law, the correspondence any successor must pass; and it has yet to be reconciled with quantum physics, leaving singularities and Planck-scale spacetime open.

oneLiner: 两件事是否「同时」发生取决于观察者的运动状态，没有绝对的全域此刻。
oneLinerEn: Whether two events are simultaneous depends on the observer's motion; there is no universal now.
detail: “同时”不是宇宙级的公共事实。1905 年爱因斯坦先给出对钟的约定：在一地发出光信号、由镜面反射返回，取往返时间的中点作为“到达的那一刻”的时刻；同一参考系里两个异地事件是否同时，从此有了可操作的判据。配上「狭义相对论基本原理」的两条公设，结论立刻出来：站台上认为同时劈中车头与车尾的两道闪电，在向前奔跑的车上人看来先中车头——因为他正朝车头来的光跑去，而扣掉传播时间后判定依然如此。定量地，沿运动方向相距 L 的两事件在新参考系里的时刻差为 vL/c² 量级（再乘一个 γ）。拿一列夸张的 1000 千米长、时速 900 千米的列车算，v=250 米每秒，差约 2.8 纳秒：小得可笑，但光一纳秒走 30 厘米，卫星定位与通信网络的对钟都必须把这类项算进去，口径见「原子钟与秒的定义」条。这里要拆掉一个常见误读：同时性的相对性不能解释成“光传到人眼需要时间，所以看到的有先后”——把传播延迟全部扣除，两个参考系仍对“是否同时”给不出一致答案，这是时空的结构，不是测量的技术故障。1908 年闵可夫斯基给出了最干净的表达：把时刻乘上光速与三个空间坐标并列成四维时空，两事件间的时空间隔 s²=c²t²−x²（三维情形取各方向之差）对所有惯性系相同，变的只是它相对各坐标轴的倾角；用他的原话说，空间本身与时间本身都注定消隐为阴影，只有二者结合才保有独立的意义。于是事件被分成三类：类时的（能被光或更慢的信号连通）先后绝对，可以构成因果链；类空的（连不通）先后随参考系颠倒，因而绝不能用来传信；类光的恰好落在边界上。每个事件周围由所有可能的光线围成一个“光锥”，锥内是它能影响的未来与能被告知的原因，锥外是永远互不通问的他处。相对论保住的不是“现在”，而是因果（速度上限见「狭义相对论基本原理」条，场的扰动以光速传变见「电磁感应」条）。“全域的此刻并不存在”也牵出现在主义与块宇宙之争，那是「万物哲学」科目的题目。两处易错：一、「时间膨胀」比的是同一处的两个时刻，本条比的是两处的时刻，两式不可互替；二、“各参考系各有说法”不等于任意，洛伦兹变换给出的差值精确可算、可验证，并且与「同时的相对性」这一名称一样，是可重复测量的事实。
detailEn: Simultaneity is no cosmic common fact. In 1905 Einstein first fixed a convention for synchronising clocks: send a light pulse from a place, reflect it back from a mirror, and take the midpoint of the round trip as the moment of arrival; whether two distant events are simultaneous in that frame is then operationally decided. Add the two postulates of special relativity and the verdict follows at once. Two lightning strokes that a platform judges to hit a train's front and rear together strike the front first for a rider running toward that flash — and the judgement survives even after light-travel time is subtracted. Quantitatively, events separated by L along the motion differ in time by about vL/c², with a further γ: for an exaggerated train 1000 km long at 900 km/h, v=250 m/s gives roughly 2.8 nanoseconds, absurdly small, yet light runs 30 cm in a nanosecond, so satellite navigation and telecom timing must carry such terms, as the entry on atomic clocks and the definition of the second spells out. A familiar misreading should be dismantled: this is not “we see things late because light takes time” — subtract every propagation delay and the two frames still disagree, which is a property of spacetime, not of instruments. Minkowski's 1908 formulation is the cleanest: multiply time by c and set it beside the three coordinates as four-dimensional spacetime, and the interval s²=c²t²−x² between two events is the same for all inertial frames, only its tilt against the axes changing; in his words, space by itself and time by itself are doomed to fade into shadows and keep reality only in their union. Events therefore fall into three classes: timelike ones, reachable by light or slower signals, keep an absolute order and can bear causal chains; spacelike ones, unreachable, trade their order between frames and so can never carry a message; lightlike ones sit on the boundary. Around each event the possible light rays trace a light cone — inside, its future and its causes; outside, regions that can never exchange news. What relativity protects is not “the now” but causality: the speed limit sits in the entry on the postulates, and fields propagate their disturbances at light speed as the entry on electromagnetic induction shows. That there is no universal present also feeds the philosophical quarrel between presentism and the block universe. Two slips: time dilation compares two instants at one place while this entry compares two places, so the formulas are not interchangeable; and “each frame has its own verdict” is not arbitrariness — the offset is exact, calculable and measured.

oneLiner: 引力与加速度在局部不可区分，这是广义相对论的基石。
oneLinerEn: Gravity and acceleration are locally indistinguishable—the cornerstone of general relativity.
detail: 引力与加速度在局部不可区分，这是广义相对论的地基。先把质量的两种身份分开：在 F=ma 里它是抵抗加速的本性，称惯性质量；在「万有引力定律」里它决定受引力的大小，称引力质量。这两个概念在逻辑上毫无必然联系，实验却一再发现它们严格相等——牛顿用过单摆，伽利略的自由落体传说家喻户晓（真实的斜面工作在「伽利略斜面实验」条），厄缶自 1889 年起用扭秤比较不同材料的下落加速度，精度做到十亿分之几；2022 年微小号（MICROSCOPE）卫星公布最终结果，把两种铍合金的加速度相对差压到 10⁻¹⁵，也就是十亿亿分之一。爱因斯坦把这个巧合升格为原理：一只密封舱里的人，无论做力学、光学、摆或钟的任何实验，都无法分辨自己是静止在地球表面，还是在深空中被火箭以 9.8 米每二次方秒匀加速拖着走。推理随即展开：舱在深空向上加速时，一束水平穿舱的光会在光飞行的时间里随舱横移，观察者看见光线弯了；既然加速能让光弯，引力也必然让光弯——1911 年爱因斯坦正是这样算出偏折值的，可惜只得对的一半，另一半要等时空弯曲补齐（见「广义相对论与时空弯曲」条）。同理，加速舱的底与顶因为「时间膨胀」而钟速不同，那么引力场里高低两处也必有差，这便是引力红移与「引力使时间变慢」的来路。为何这一条足以把引力几何化：既然自由下落能在局部消去引力，自由落体就不是“受力的运动”而是“不受力的运动”，即沿测地线的惯性运动；两物相互靠近不再是有力在拉，而是它们走的路径本身在弯曲的时空里收拢。引力的座次由此从“一种力”改成“时空的形状”。必须补上的限制是“局部”：舱够大时，两只各自下落的球会缓缓靠近，因为它们都朝地心收敛，这种消不掉的相对加速叫潮汐，正是曲率的定义本身（潮汐的极端形态见「黑洞」条）。日常最亲切的例子是绕地飞船里的失重，配合「三个宇宙速度」与「卫星变轨与轨道转移」两条看：舱内飘着不是因为没引力（四百千米高处的引力仍有地面的约九成），而是舱与舱内一切以同一加速度一起下落。三点易错：一、等效原理只在小区域、短时间内成立；二、它说的是局域不可分辨，不是说引力与加速在起源上完全同源；三、惯性质量与引力质量相等是实验事实，别把它当成定义——正因它不是定义，这条原理才有内容。
detailEn: Gravity and acceleration are locally indistinguishable, and that is the cornerstone of general relativity. First separate the two faces of mass: in F=ma it is resistance to acceleration, inertial mass; in the law of universal gravitation it sets how strongly a body is pulled, gravitational mass. Nothing in logic marries the two, yet experiment keeps finding them strictly equal — Newton used pendulums, Galileo's falling-body story is famous (the real inclined-plane work sits in its own entry), and from 1889 Eötvös compared the fall of different materials with a torsion balance to a few parts in a billion; the MICROSCOPE satellite's final 2022 result pushes the relative difference between two beryllium alloys to 10⁻¹⁵, one part in a thousand trillion. Einstein promoted the coincidence to a principle: inside a sealed cabin no experiment — mechanical, optical, pendulum or clock — can tell someone whether they rest on Earth or are dragged through deep space at 9.8 m/s². The reasoning runs at once: in a cabin accelerating upward, a horizontal beam of light is seen to curve because the floor gains on it mid-flight; if acceleration bends light, gravity must too. Einstein computed a deflection this way in 1911 and got exactly half the right answer, the other half waiting for curved spacetime. Likewise, floor and ceiling of the accelerating cabin keep time at different rates through time dilation, so a gravitational field must also grade clock rates with height — the route to the gravitational redshift and to gravitational time dilation. Why is this enough to geometrise gravity? Because free fall can erase gravity locally, falling is not motion under a force but forceless motion along a geodesic, and two bodies drawing nearer do so not because something pulls but because their paths converge in curved spacetime. Gravity is demoted from a force to a feature of geometry. The saving clause is “locally”: in a large cabin two freely falling spheres creep together because both head for Earth's centre, and that irreducible relative acceleration — the tide — is curvature itself, whose extreme form is spelled out in the entry on black holes. The homeliest instance is weightlessness in orbit, read together with the entries on cosmic velocities and orbital manoeuvres: things float at 400 km not because gravity is gone (it is still some ninety per cent of surface strength) but because cabin and contents fall together. Three slips: the principle holds only in small regions for short times; local indistinguishability is not identity of origin; and the equality of inertial and gravitational mass is an experimental fact, not a definition — which is precisely what gives the principle its content.

oneLiner: 引力越强、时钟走得越慢；山脚的表比山顶的略慢。
oneLinerEn: The stronger the gravity, the slower clocks run; a clock at a mountain's foot lags one at its peak.
detail: 引力越强，钟走得越慢，这条效应叫引力时间膨胀。弱场里两处钟的相对快慢差等于引力势差除以光速平方，地面附近简化成 Δf/f=gh/c²，式中 g 为重力加速度、h 为高度差、c 为光速：一米的高度差对应约 1.1×10⁻¹⁶ 的相对频差，一年累积约 3 纳秒，所以一个人头与脚的钟差，用整整一生也攒不满一微秒。精确写法来自「广义相对论与时空弯曲」条的史瓦西解：质量 M 附近钟的节拍按 √(1−2GM/(rc²)) 缩小，越近越慢，r 缩到 2GM/c²（史瓦西半径）时因子归零——那正是「黑洞」条的事件视界，远处观察者会看到下落的钟越走越慢、光越走越红，最终像“冻”在视界上。第一个在地面把它量出来的是 1960 年的庞德与雷布卡：他们让 14.4 千电子伏的 γ 射线沿哈佛塔的 22.5 米竖直上下来回，用穆斯堡尔效应压掉热运动与多普勒噪声，测得约 2.5×10⁻¹⁵ 的频率移动，与预言在百分之十内相符，后续复测把不确定度压到百分之一量级。天体上数量级立刻抬升：太阳表面的钟每天比远处慢约 0.2 秒，白矮星在千分之一量级，中子星（半径十来千米、质量一到两倍太阳）表面钟的节拍只剩远处的约四分之三，接近黑洞视界的钟几乎停摆。在导航卫星上这是每天的事务：GPS 卫星在约两万千米的轨道上，因离地心远、引力势更高，它的钟每天比地面快约 45 微秒；与「时间膨胀」的速度项每天慢约 7 微秒相抵，净快 38 微秒，出厂前就得先把频率偏掉，否则定位误差每天累积十来公里——完整账目见「原子钟与秒的定义」条。科幻里的“天上一日、地上一年”在本条的尺度上绝不可能：地球上的引力差只是纳秒级，要挣到成倍的时间差必须深入强场，而那里的潮汐与辐射先要人命（见「黑洞」与「恒星的一生」两条）。今天这只钟灵敏到能用厘米称高度：光钟的不确定度进入 10⁻¹⁸，抬起约一厘米就能看见频率变化，反过来用一组钟即可绘出重力势地图，用于监测地下水、岩浆活动与地壳形变，这是「数量级估算」条所说把极小量变成的可测信号。两处易错：一、引力是让低处的钟走得慢，不是让它走得乱；二、它与速度造成的钟慢是两笔独立的账，符号可以相反，卫星与环球飞行实验必须两笔一起结算。
detailEn: The stronger the gravity, the slower clocks run — gravitational time dilation. In weak fields the fractional rate difference equals the difference in gravitational potential divided by c², which near the ground simplifies to Δf/f=gh/c², with g the gravitational field, h the height difference and c the speed of light: one metre of height gives about 1.1×10⁻¹⁶, roughly 3 nanoseconds a year, so the gap between a person's head and feet never fills a microsecond across a whole lifetime. The exact statement comes from the Schwarzschild solution of general relativity: near a mass M a clock's pace is reduced by √(1−2GM/(rc²)), slower the closer you sit, and at r=2GM/c² — the Schwarzschild radius — the factor reaches zero, which is the event horizon described in the entry on black holes, where a distant watcher sees a falling clock freeze and its light redden without end. Pound and Rebka first measured it on the ground in 1960, sending 14.4 keV gamma rays up and down a 22.5 m tower and using the Mössbauer effect to strip Doppler noise: about 2.5×10⁻¹⁵ in fractional shift, agreeing with prediction within ten per cent, later refined to about one per cent. Bodies in space lift the scale at once: a clock on the Sun's surface loses roughly 0.2 seconds a day against a distant one, a white dwarf is in the parts-per-thousand range, a neutron star of ten-odd kilometres and one to two solar masses keeps only about three quarters of the faraway beat, and near a horizon clocks all but stop. For navigation satellites this is routine bookkeeping: GPS orbits at some twenty thousand kilometres, sits higher in the potential and gains about 45 microseconds a day, the velocity term of time dilation takes back about 7, and the net 38 must be built into the frequency before launch or position error grows ten-odd kilometres daily, as the entry on atomic clocks and the definition of the second records. Science-fiction's “a day aloft, a year below” is impossible at Earth's scale — nanoseconds at best; earning day-versus-year gaps demands strong fields, where tides and radiation kill you first. Today the clock is sensitive enough to weigh height in centimetres: optical clocks reach 10⁻¹⁸, so lifting one is visible, and a network of clocks now maps gravitational potential over aquifers, magma and deforming crust. Two slips: gravity slows lower clocks rather than disordering them; and it is a separate account from velocity-based dilation, with the opposite sign possible, so satellites and round-the-world flights must settle both lines together.

oneLiner: 物体速度越接近光速，加速它越难，等效惯性随之增大。
oneLinerEn: The closer to light speed, the harder to accelerate—an effective rise in inertia.
detail: 这条关系讲的是：动得越快，再加速越难。今天的准确表述是动量按 p=γmv 增长，式中 p 为动量、m 为不变质量（静质量）、v 为速率、γ=1/√(1−v²/c²) 随速度升高而发散；因为 γ 趋于无穷，把任何有质量的物体推到光速需要无穷能量，光速因此成为不可逾越的门槛。老教材爱写“质量随速度增大”，把 γm 称为运动质量，算数不错却容易误导：它让人以为物体里的物质变多了，还会引出纵向与横向不同的“有效质量”——F=ma 的形状在此不再成立，正确的写法是 F=dp/dt，力与加速度甚至可以不同向。与「质能方程」条合起来可写成能量—动量关系 E²=(pc)²+(mc²)²：静能 mc² 是速度为零时的能量；光子静质量为零却仍有动量 p=E/c，故光能推动他物——彗尾背向太阳、光压与太阳帆都靠它（见「光子」条）。代价有多大，看两台机器：把电子推到 104 GeV 时 γ 约二十万，电子只比光速慢约 3.6 毫米每秒；7 TeV 的质子 γ 约 7460，比光速慢约 2.7 米每秒——再喂能量，速度几乎不动，全部涨在 γ 上。这直接决定机器的设计：回旋加速器若固定交变电压的频率，粒子一进相对论区就会与加速电场失步，必须同步调频或改换磁场与轨道结构，口径见「洛伦兹力」「粒子加速器」与「交变电流」三条。速度也不能简单相加：同向的两段速度 u′ 与 v 合成 u=(u′+v)/(1+u′v/c²)，0.5c 加 0.5c 得 0.8c，0.9c 加 0.9c 得 0.994c，永远够不到 c，这是洛伦兹变换（见「狭义相对论基本原理」条）的直接后果。菲佐 1851 年测流动水中的光速，得到的“拖曳系数”恰为 1−1/n²，n 为水的折射率约 1.33，系数约 0.44，正是上式的一阶近似（口径见「光的折射」条）——一场十九世纪的水与光实验因此成了相对论的前注。三点易错：一、“越接近光速越难推”涨的是能量与动量，不是物体能装下更多物质；二、加速器里的电子越跑越“钝”并非因为阻力，真空中没有「摩擦力」可谈，这是时空给动量定的规矩；三、本条与「时间膨胀」「长度收缩」同出一个 γ，三式连用才不自相矛盾，例如算束流寿命时必须一起结算。它也解释了一个常见错觉：为什么宇宙射线里的质子能穿过整个星系而不停下——不是因为推力大，而是因为对它们自己而言，沿途的路程被「长度收缩」条的那条式子缩短了。
detailEn: This relation says the faster you go, the harder it is to accelerate further. Today the precise form is that momentum grows as p=γmv, with p the momentum, m the invariant (rest) mass, v the speed and γ=1/√(1−v²/c²) diverging as v approaches c; because γ runs to infinity, pushing any massive body to light speed would take infinite energy, and that is why c is a threshold rather than a record. Older textbooks speak of “mass increasing with speed” and call γm the relativistic mass; the arithmetic is fine but the language misleads, hinting that the body contains more stuff and spawning different “effective masses” lengthwise and crosswise. In truth F=ma no longer holds in that shape — the correct statement is F=dp/dt, and force and acceleration need not even point the same way. Combined with mass–energy equivalence one writes E²=(pc)²+(mc²)²: mc² is the energy at zero speed, while a photon, massless, still carries momentum p=E/c and so can push things, which is why comet tails point away from the Sun and why light sails work, as the entry on the photon notes. How steep the price is, two machines show: electrons at 104 GeV have γ near two hundred thousand and travel only some 3.6 millimetres per second below light speed; 7 TeV protons, γ about 7460, lag by roughly 2.7 metres per second — feed in more energy and the speed barely moves while γ climbs. This dictates design: a cyclotron with fixed-frequency voltage loses synchronism once particles turn relativistic, so frequency must track γ or magnet and orbit geometry change, as the entries on the Lorentz force, particle accelerators and alternating current explain. Velocities do not add naively either: collinear u′ and v combine as u=(u′+v)/(1+u′v/c²), so 0.5c plus 0.5c is 0.8c and 0.9c plus 0.9c is 0.994c, forever short of c — a direct read-off from the Lorentz transformation. Fizeau's 1851 measurement of light in flowing water returned a dragging coefficient of exactly 1−1/n², about 0.44 for water with refractive index 1.33, the first-order form of that same addition law, as the entry on refraction records; a nineteenth-century experiment with water and light thereby became a preface to relativity. Three slips: nearing light speed raises energy and momentum, not the amount of matter; electrons in storage rings grow “sluggish” with no friction anywhere, since it is spacetime's rule for momentum, not a drag; and this relation shares its γ with time dilation and length contraction, so beam lifetimes and cosmic-ray reach must be computed with all three together — which is also why a proton from deep space can cross a galaxy in its own account, the journey having contracted.
